      public A2ACardResolver_v0_3(String baseUrl) throws A2AClientError_v0_3
      Get the agent card for an A2A agent. The HTTP client will be auto-selected via A2AHttpClientFactory.
      Parameters:
      baseUrl - the base URL for the agent whose agent card we want to retrieve
      Throws:
      A2AClientError_v0_3 - if the URL for the agent is invalid

      Parameters:

      Parameters:
